summary: Dependable, high-ownership Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience engineering secure, scalable web, mobile, and desktop applications. Proficient in modern frontend architectures (React, TypeScript), backend microservices (Python, FastAPI, Node.js), and high-performance databases (PostgreSQL, PostGIS, Redis). Known for extreme reliability, zero-ego collaboration with cross-functional teams, and accelerated learning agility—rapidly mastering complex domain logic such as satellite telemetry, geospatial visualizations (Leaflet, Mapbox), and real-time streaming to deliver resilient, mission-critical systems.

highlights: Architected and deployed responsive web, mobile, and desktop applications using React, Python (FastAPI), and Node.js, maintaining 99.8% system reliability and strict milestone delivery.
Built interactive, real-time analytics dashboards integrating geospatial map layers (Leaflet, Mapbox) and time-series telemetry data for fast situational decision-making.
Engineered scalable RESTful APIs and microservices handling 250k+ daily transactions with low latency, secured via JWT authentication and role-based access controls.
Optimized database architectures across PostgreSQL and Redis, restructuring complex spatial and relational queries to cut retrieval times by 42%.
Collaborated proactively with GIS analysts, QA engineers, and cybersecurity specialists to establish automated CI/CD deployment pipelines and comprehensive API documentation.
Developed cross-platform mobile and web client interfaces using React and React Native, ensuring seamless performance across diverse device ecosystems.
Implemented real-time event streaming and alert pipelines using WebSockets and message queues to push instant updates to client interfaces.
Containerized core microservices with Docker, reducing environment inconsistencies and cutting staging deployment friction by 50%.
Conducted thorough unit and integration testing to ensure fault tolerance, zero data loss, and smooth integration with third-party cloud services.
